players.product: Polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP pads) and for silicon wafers (Polishing Pad Business)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025) consolidated results: net sales JPY 22,528 million, up JPY 1,468 million (7.0%) year on year; operating profit JPY 3,771 million, up 26.0%; ordinary profit JPY 3,904 million, up 27.1%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 2,730 million, up 30.3%.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 22,528 million net sales (+7.0%); JPY 3,771 million operating profit (+26.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Polishing Pad Business H1 FY2026: CMP pad orders increased on rising demand for memory such as HBM and for leading-edge logic semiconductors as generative AI spreads, together with some users raising their inventory levels; silicon wafer pads secured a certain level of sales (general-purpose demand weak, advanced-product demand firm); hard disk demand for data centers returned and LCD glass orders rose on China's subsidy policy. Segment net sales JPY 10,744 million (+16.7%), operating profit JPY 2,918 million (+37.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 10,744 million segment net sales (+16.7%); JPY 2,918 million segment operating profit (+37.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Chemicals Business H1 FY2026: contract-manufacturing orders firm on the continued expansion of the electronic materials market, including semiconductors, and a gradual agrochemical recovery; Yanai and Takefu plants kept generally high utilization. Segment net sales JPY 7,212 million (+5.7%), operating profit JPY 726 million (+22.1%); non-current assets rose JPY 1,739 million mainly on capital expenditure in this business.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 7,212 million segment net sales (+5.7%); JPY 726 million segment operating profit (+22.1%)
